A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MLLM-CD study. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–E are readable and can be matched despite pagination changes and checklist relocation.

before.justification: Section 4 and Appendix D report original factor-identification and causal-structure experiments on MAG and Lung Cancer, including ablations and parameter analyses.

after.justification: V2 retains these original experiments and adds sampling-strategy comparisons in Section 4.4, Table 4.

M1.justification: The contrastive factor discovery, statistical structure discovery, and counterfactual refinement procedures are retained. Algorithm 1's added iteration-counter increment makes the already-described iterative process explicit; the new RAG and knowledge-graph suggestions are recommendations, not implemented components.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate text–image causal discovery on the same 200-sample MAG and 60-sample Lung Cancer datasets. The added sampling ablation introduces no new dataset, modality, population, or task.

E2.justification: The main comparisons retain META, Pairwise, Triplet, and COAT. V2's Table 4 adds comparisons against sampling variants, including Simple Pair, intra-modal-only, and inter-modal-only selection.

E3.justification: The new sampling comparison specifies random selection within target categories, pairing by maximum target-value difference, and separate intra-modal and inter-modal selection. Existing dataset sizes, metrics, backbones, and Appendix D.3 settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: New Table 4 tests the internal sampling design of contrastive factor discovery, extending v1's whole-module removal ablations. The existing alternative-CD-algorithm, parameter-sensitivity, and case-study analyses remain.

E5.justification: Both versions report uncertainty using standard deviations, as identified in their checklists. V2 adds no run-count, seed, confidence-interval, or significance-testing information; revised deviation values are result changes.

E6.justification: Table 4 adds sampling-strategy results. In the MAG ablation table, GPT-4o MLLM-CD's NF changes from 0.89 ± 0.00 to 0.84 ± 0.09 and ESHD from 14.33 ± 0.58 to 15.33 ± 2.31; Gemini's ESHD changes from 13.33 ± 2.31 to 14.00 ± 3.46 (v1 Table 7; v2 Table 8), matching the retained main results. Lung Cancer's averaged Pairwise/Triplet node metrics become dashes. Averages added to main Tables 1–2 already existed in v1's appendix.

T1.justification: The substantive mathematical definitions and complexity analysis are retained. Equation (5) cleans up the notation for non-descendant-set cardinality. The checklist changes its theoretical-results answer from Yes to NA, but no theorem or proof is actually removed.

C1.justification: The framework, principal components, benchmark contribution, and claims of empirical effectiveness retain their scope. The added 'to the best of our knowledge' qualifier and reworded contribution bullet do not establish a different substantive contribution.

C2.justification: Section 3.4 now explains why a nonzero consistency threshold permits correction of an imperfect graph and discusses domain-expertise limitations and possible RAG/knowledge-graph remedies. Section 4.4 adds interpretations of complementary intra/inter-modal sampling. Most limitations expanded into the conclusion already appeared in Appendix B.

D1.justification: Algorithm 1 supplies the omitted iteration-counter update, and several checklist references are corrected to point to experimental documentation in Appendix D. Hardware, hyperparameters, substantive prompts, and code/data access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds discussion and citations on causal representation learning, distinguishing latent representation identifiability from human-interpretable factor discovery. Additional references support missing-data discovery and RAG/knowledge-graph recommendations. The principal positioning relative to COAT remains.

P1.justification: V2 adds bounded explanatory passages, expands the conclusion using existing appendix material, adds acknowledgments, and corrects wording and cross-references. The checklist moves before the appendices, while the research narrative and section hierarchy remain largely intact.

P2.justification: V2 adds sampling-ablation Table 4 and displays previously appendix-only average rows in main Tables 1–2. It compacts the notation table, adjusts table spacing, and relocates existing material. The figure content is retained.

improvement.justification: The new sampling ablation supplies more direct support for the CFD design, while revised appendix entries resolve inconsistencies with the main results. Clearer validation reasoning, corrected pseudocode, and broader research context improve interpretability and reporting. These are limited gains: the central method and empirical coverage remain unchanged.
